sql:
SELECT a.element 
FROM atom a 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM molecule 
    WHERE label = '-' 
    GROUP BY molecule_id
) non_carcinogenic ON a.molecule_id = non_carcinogenic.molecule_id 
GROUP BY a.element 
ORDER BY COUNT(a.element) ASC 
LIMIT 1
